what: Check Point Software sells network and cloud security. Its firewalls and security gateways protect corporate networks, and it also sells cloud, email and endpoint protection managed from one console.
customers: Enterprises, government agencies and service providers worldwide.
money: cloud, email and threat prevention subscriptions
moat: Security appliances embedded in network architectures with configurations and policies built up over years, which makes replacement a project rather than a purchase.
risks: Growth of about 6% is far slower than its faster-growing rivals
It has lost share in next-generation firewalls to Palo Alto and Fortinet
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Operating margin of 30% and return on invested capital of 23%
Gross margin of 87% with cash exceeding debt
Consistent large buybacks have shrunk the share count for years
watch: Billings growth and the subscription share of revenue.
